header.running_head: Honouring the Household Members of Rasulullaah ﷺ's Family

blocks.text: Sa'd that I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say such things about Ali (RA) that I would never revile him even if a saw is placed on my head."[^1]
Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) Forbids Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) from Insulting Hadhrat Ali (RA)

Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Mu'aawiya bin Abu Sufyaan (RA) once instructed him saying, "What prevents you from reviling Abu Turaab (Hadhrat Ali (RA))?" Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) replied, "If I had to my credit even one of the three virtues that Rasulullaah ﷺ mentioned for Ali (RA), I would prefer this to having red camels. I cannot revile him as long as I remember these. When Rasulullaah ﷺ appointed Ali (RA) as his deputy (in Madinah) when leaving for one of the battles, Ali (RA) asked, 'O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Are you leaving me behind with the women and children?' I then heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'Would you not like your relationship with me to be like the relationship between Haaroon (AS) and Moosa (AS). Of course, there shall be no Nabi after me.' I also heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say during the Battle of Khaybar, 'I shall give the flag to someone who loves Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ and whom Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ also love.' I also hoped to get it but Rasulullaah ﷺ then asked for Ali (RA) to be summoned. When brought before Rasulullaah ﷺ, he was suffering from pain in his eyes. Rasulullaah ﷺ put some of his blessed saliva into Ali (RA)'s eyes (thus curing them) and handed the flag over to him. Allaah then granted the conquest at his hand. Furthermore, it was Ali (RA), Faatima (RA), Hasan (RA) and Husayn (RA) whom Rasulullaah ﷺ called for when Allaah revealed the verse:

blocks.arabic_text: فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا نَدْعُ اَبْنَآءَنَا وَاَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمْ وَاَنْفُسَنَا وَاَنْفُسَكُمْ
blocks.text: Say to them (O Rasulullaah ﷺ), "Come! We shall call your sons and our sons, your wives and our wives, yourselves and ourselves...
Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "O Allaah! This is my family."[^2]

Hadhrat Abu Nujayh narrates that when Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) performed Hajj, he took hold of the hand of Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA) and said, "O Abu Is'haaq! We are people whom all these battles have distanced from the Hajj to the extent that we have almost forgotten some of its Sunnah practices. You perform the Tawaaf and we will follow you." After the Tawaaf was complete, Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) took Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) into Daarun Nadwa where he seated him upon his chair. He then spoke of Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Taalib (RA) and spoke ill of him.
Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) said, "You brought me into your room, seated me on your chair and then start to speak ill of Ali (RA)?! By Allaah! More than everything
Abu Ya'la, reporting from reliable sources as confirmed by Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.130).
